verdict.rationale: The suite is API- and CLI-driven, so it can run without a UI. `stripe sandbox create` provisions an anonymous sandbox with working API keys and no registration, which suits ephemeral CI environments. `mppx validate` tests an MPP implementation end-to-end, and catalog imports, checkout hooks and order fulfillment all run through APIs, webhooks and restricted keys rather than the Dashboard. Link CLI wallet spends and some MCP write actions deliberately require human approval, so fully unattended purchase flows are not possible. Missing for 10: explicit CI/pipeline guidance or examples, independent hands-on corroboration of CI usage, and unattended operation for human-gated Link spends and MCP write actions.
